chunk_content: Performance by Category B. Data Tables C. Layering Achievements D. Layering Data Tables The four tabs are described in detail below; A. Performance by Category Tab: On this tab, the performance of each intervention is displayed against the annual targets. It has 8 key sections as shown in the screen shot below. A description of each section is also given. 1) Target achievement by intervention category: This visual shows the percent achievement against target of the selected intervention category 2) Number of IPs- this shows the number of IPs whose data is being displayed 3) Target and achievement per category: Display absolute numbers of the target and achievement of the selected intervention category. 4) Percent achievement: Displays the percentage achievement of the selected intervention category 5) Achievement by age group: Displays the target and achievement by age group or county for the selected intervention category 6) Refresh date: Shows the date that the data being displayed was last refreshed 7) Achievement by quarter, IP, agency: Displays the percent achievement for the selected intervention category by the selected attribute; quarter, IP or agency 8) Filters: While in the performance tab, you can apply the following filters; a. Agency b. IP c. Age group d. County e. Target annual period; The FY of interest f. Achievement SA, Qtr: The semi-annual period and quarter of interest g. Achievements within targets: Refers to services offered to AGYW for whom USG had set targets 2) # of IPs 1) Target achievement by intervention category Visual 3) Target & Achievement per category values 4) % Achievement 5) Achievement by age group /County visual 6) Refresh Date 7) Achievement by quarter, agency and IP Visual 8) Filters h. Achievements outside targets: Refers to services offered to AGYW whom USG had not set targets e.g. If MLRC is offered to an AGYW aged 16 years, this service will be counted under achievement outside target since MLRC is not meant for this age group and hence there are no MLRC targets for 16 years old AGYW. B. Data Tables Tab: This tab provides achievement against targets data for each intervention category. This data can be exported in excel format for further analysis. The same filters that in the performance by category tab are also available on this tab. C. Layering Achievements Tab: On this tab, the AGYW layering status is displayed. Computation of layering is based on the AGYW-PREV indicator as described in MER indicator reference guide. This tab has 8 key sections as shown in the screen shot below, each section is also described. 1) Buttons: The data displayed depends on which of the following buttons you have selected; age group, time in DREAMs, county, agency or IP 2) Number of IPs- this shows the number of IPs whose data is being displayed 3) Number of active beneficiaries: This is the number of AGYW who meet the criteria of being active in DREAMS at any given time.
